cities.tokyo_desc: All Taiwan-related cultural events across Tokyo — film screenings, exhibitions, music, lectures, and food markets. Tokyo hosts the highest density of Taiwan events in Japan, with a rich programme every month.
cities.osaka_desc: Taiwan cultural events in the Osaka area, including Kansai premieres, exhibitions, and exchange programmes. Osaka has a vibrant Taiwan community and is a key hub for Japan-Taiwan connections.
cities.kyoto_desc: Taiwan art, film, and academic events in Kyoto. The ancient city's historic atmosphere and Taiwan's diverse creativity intersect here, attracting Taiwanese artists and scholars every year.
cities.fukuoka_desc: Taiwan cultural events in Fukuoka. Geographically close to Taiwan, Fukuoka enjoys frequent exchange across community, business, and culture, making it one of the most active Japan-Taiwan cities.
cities.sapporo_desc: Taiwan events in Sapporo and Hokkaido — seasonal cultural festivals, food markets, and exchange activities. Hokkaido's stunning natural landscapes attract large numbers of Taiwanese visitors and a growing events calendar.
cities.nagoya_desc: Taiwan cultural events in Nagoya and the Aichi region. Strategically located, Nagoya is an important base for Taiwan culture radiating into the Tokai area.
cities.tokyo_descLong: Tokyo is the densest hub of Taiwan-related cultural activity in Japan. The Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office, the Taiwan Cultural Centre and the Taiwan Chamber of Commerce in Tokyo regularly programme exhibitions, film screenings, lectures and business networking events. Independent venues across Shinjuku, Shibuya and Ikebukuro frequently host Taiwanese music and culinary events. K's cinema, Theatre Image Forum and Eurospace consistently programme Taiwanese arthouse cinema. This page aggregates every Taiwan-related event detected across Tokyo's 23 wards and the Tama region, updated daily.
cities.osaka_descLong: Osaka is the heart of Japan-Taiwan exchange in the Kansai region. The Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Osaka, Hankyu Railway, Hanshin Department Store, and Daimaru Matsuzakaya frequently collaborate on Taiwan product fairs and Taiwan Month events. Independent cinemas in Namba, Shinsaibashi and Umeda (Cine Libre Umeda, Theatre Seven) regularly screen Taiwanese films. The annual Taiwan Festa draws large crowds from the local Taiwanese diaspora. This page aggregates Taiwan-related events across Osaka City and Osaka Prefecture.
cities.kyoto_descLong: Kyoto's historical atmosphere and Taiwan's multifaceted creativity intersect here every year, drawing many Taiwanese artists, scholars and creators for residencies. Kyoto University, Ritsumeikan and Kyoto Prefectural University regularly host Taiwan studies lectures and academic conferences. KYOTOGRAPHIE International Photography Festival and the Kyoto International Film Festival frequently include Taiwanese works. This page aggregates Taiwan-related arts, academic and cinema events across Kyoto Prefecture.
cities.fukuoka_descLong: Fukuoka, geographically the closest major city to Taiwan, hosts some of Japan's most active Japan-Taiwan grassroots exchange. The Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Fukuoka, the Fukuoka Taiwanese Association, and ACROS Fukuoka have long supported Taiwan cultural promotion. KBC Cinema and Cine Libre Hakata Eki regularly screen Taiwanese films. The annual Taiwan Festa Fukuoka has grown into Kyushu's largest Taiwan cultural event. This page aggregates Taiwan-related events across Fukuoka Prefecture.
cities.sapporo_descLong: Sapporo and Hokkaido have grown closer to Taiwan in recent years through tourism, agricultural exchange and the Snow Festival. Hokkaido University has long supported Taiwan studies; Sapporo, Hakodate and Otaru periodically host Taiwan cultural showcases, food markets and film screenings. The Sapporo Snow Festival itself draws large numbers of Taiwanese visitors and is increasingly accompanied by Taiwan-themed programming. This page aggregates Taiwan-related events across Hokkaido.
cities.nagoya_descLong: Nagoya, situated at the transport hub of central Japan, has become an important radiating point for Taiwanese culture across the Tokai region. Chukyo University and Aichi Prefectural University offer Taiwan-related courses and lectures; Midland Square Cinema and Cinema Skhole regularly programme Taiwanese films. This page aggregates Taiwan-related events across Aichi Prefecture and Nagoya City.

categoryDesc.noEvents: No ongoing events at the moment.
categoryDesc.movie: Aggregating Taiwan films screening across Japan — theatrical releases, special screenings, and film festivals. Official info and dates updated daily.
categoryDesc.performing_arts: Taiwan music concerts, dance, theater, and performing arts events across Japan — from intimate venues to major concert halls.
categoryDesc.senses: Events to experience Taiwan through the senses — Taiwanese food festivals, markets, and multisensory experiences.
categoryDesc.photography: Photography exhibitions, photographer talks, photo workshops, and photobooks
categoryDesc.art: Taiwan art exhibitions, visual arts, and contemporary art events across Japan — from gallery shows to major museum exhibitions.
categoryDesc.lecture: Lectures, symposia, and knowledge events about Taiwan across Japan — history, culture, society, language, and more.
categoryDesc.taiwan_japan: Events focused on Japan-Taiwan exchange — cultural visits, sister city events, business networking, and people-to-people friendship activities.
categoryDesc.lifestyle_food: Events celebrating Taiwanese food culture and lifestyle — cooking classes, food markets, and lifestyle workshops.
categoryDesc.books_media: Events related to Taiwanese books, literature, publishing, and media — book clubs, author talks, and literary exhibitions.
categoryDesc.movie_long: This page aggregates Taiwanese films currently or soon screening across Japan, including new theatrical releases, special screenings, restored re-releases, and entries at major festivals (Tokyo International Film Festival, Osaka Asian Film Festival, Kyoto International Film Festival, TAIWAN PLUS, Taiwan FAASAI, etc.). Every film is tagged with premiere date, screening cinema, and any director / cast Q&A sessions, with links to official information. Data is updated daily from cinema websites, festival platforms and PR Times.
categoryDesc.performing_arts_long: This page collects Taiwanese music concerts, dance, theatre and traditional performing arts events across Japan. Coverage spans LIVEHOUSE-scale venues (Shimokitazawa MOON ROMANTIC, Aoyama Tsukimi-ru Kimi-Omou) up to major concert halls (Bunkamura, Tokyo Bunka Kaikan, Suntory Hall). Includes touring performances by Taiwan's National Symphony Orchestra, Cloud Gate Dance Theatre, Ming Hwa Yuan, and other flagship companies.
categoryDesc.senses_long: "Senses & Identity" is a category unique to this site, gathering events that introduce Taiwan through food, scent, touch and other sensory experiences. Coverage includes Taiwanese night-market pop-ups, tea ceremony workshops, perfume tastings, Hakka lei-cha sessions, indigenous music and culinary workshops. These events are often the best entry point for first encounters with Taiwanese culture, and important gathering occasions for the Taiwanese community in Japan.
categoryDesc.art_long: This page covers Taiwanese art exhibitions on view across Japan, from contemporary art gallery shows reported by Whitestone Gallery and Tokyo Art Beat, through to major public museum exhibitions at the Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo, the Tokyo Bunka Kaikan and the Kyoto National Museum of Modern Art. Coverage spans contemporary painting, photography, sculpture, new media and indigenous art. Every exhibition includes opening date, exhibition period, venue and an official link.
categoryDesc.lecture_long: This page collects Taiwan-themed lectures, symposia, reading groups and knowledge events across Japan, covering Taiwanese history, politics, society, literature, language, Hakka culture, indigenous issues and more. Hosts include Waseda University's Taiwan Research Institute, the University of Tokyo Taiwan Research Group, JATS (Japan Association for Taiwan Studies), the Japan-Taiwan Exchange Association, and many regional Taiwan studies societies.
categoryDesc.taiwan_japan_long: This page focuses on Japan-Taiwan exchange, covering sister-city anniversaries, business networking, youth exchange programmes, cultural visits hosted by Japan-Taiwan friendship associations, and diplomatic functions hosted by the representative offices. Also includes long-running people-to-people events from civic groups (Taiwanese associations, Japan-Taiwan Youth Network). The most comprehensive single window on Japan-Taiwan relations dynamics.
categoryDesc.lifestyle_food_long: This page focuses on Taiwanese food culture and lifestyle, with cooking classes, night-market pop-ups, Taiwanese tea workshops, coffee tastings, izakaya openings, and lifestyle workshops featuring Taiwanese designer goods, skincare and stationery. Coverage spans the full range from Michelin-listed Taiwanese restaurants to local Taiwanese eateries across Japan.
categoryDesc.books_media_long: This page covers events around Taiwanese books, literature, publishing and media, including author visits and reading sessions (Wu Ming-yi, Yang Shuang-zi, Chi Ta-wei, Wu Hsiao-le, etc.), publication launches for Japanese translations of Taiwanese literature, Japanese-version premieres of Taiwanese films and manga, and conferences on the Taiwanese media industry. We collaborate with Hakusuisha, Kankan-bou, and Tarojiro-sha among others to aggregate this information.
categoryDesc.academic: Academic exchange events: conferences, research presentations, academic forums, and lecture series focused on Taiwan studies across humanities, social, and natural sciences.
categoryDesc.business: Business and industry events: Taiwan-Japan business exchanges, startup forums, industry expos, and demo days.
categoryDesc.competition: Competitions and contests: speech competitions, creative submissions, film contests, and language proficiency tests.
categoryDesc.documentary: Documentary screenings and post-screening talks: non-fiction works exploring Taiwanese social issues, historical memory, and human stories.
categoryDesc.drama: Theatre and stage performances: Taiwanese troupes touring Japan, Taiwan-Japan collaborations, and experimental theatre.
categoryDesc.exhibition: Exhibitions: art, photography, design, and special collections covering Taiwanese contemporary and classic works.
categoryDesc.design_craft: Design and craft events: Taiwanese design exhibitions, handmade workshops, traditional crafts (ceramics, weaving, lacquerware, metalwork, woodwork), product showcases, and craft markets.
categoryDesc.herbal: Spice, herb, and medicinal cuisine events: Taiwanese Chinese medicine, herbal pharmacy, medicinal cooking (yao-shan), spice tastings, herbal tea workshops, and wellness lectures.
categoryDesc.folklore: Folklore and faith events: Taiwanese traditional folk beliefs (Mazu, Wangye, Chenghuang) and temple culture presented in Japan.
categoryDesc.gender: Gender topics: LGBTQ+, feminism, and gender equality advocacy. Cross-cultural dialogue between Taiwan and Japan.
categoryDesc.geopolitics: Geopolitics and international affairs: cross-strait situation, Indo-Pacific strategy, Taiwan-Japan security dialogue, and policy discussions.
categoryDesc.healthcare: Healthcare events: Taiwanese medical experience sharing, long-term care, public health, and traditional medicine exchanges.
categoryDesc.history: History-related events: Taiwan history, Japanese colonial era, postwar history, and oral history presentations and public lectures.
categoryDesc.indigenous: Indigenous culture events: music, dance, crafts, languages, and documentaries from Taiwan's 16 indigenous peoples.
categoryDesc.literature: Literature events: Taiwanese authors visiting Japan, book launches, literary translation discussions, and reading groups.
categoryDesc.market: Markets and product fairs: pop-up markets featuring Taiwanese ingredients, handicrafts, souvenirs, and agricultural products.
categoryDesc.nature: Nature and ecology events: lectures and exhibitions on Taiwan's mountains, oceans, biodiversity, and sustainability.
categoryDesc.parenting: Parenting and family events: Taiwan-Japan cross-cultural parenting, picture book readings, and children's cultural experiences.
categoryDesc.report: Reports and presentations: research outcome reports, survey releases, annual reviews, and policy evaluations.
categoryDesc.retail: Retail and brand events: Taiwanese brand pop-up stores, new product launches, and curated shop events.
categoryDesc.scholarship: Scholarship and grant events: Taiwan-Japan scholarship briefings, open calls, and academic exchange program funding.
categoryDesc.study_abroad: Study abroad events: information sessions, exchange programs, university application briefings, and Taiwan-Japan cross-cultural study programs.
categoryDesc.taiwan_mandarin: Taiwanese Mandarin events: Mandarin teaching, language and cultural experiences, and proficiency tests.
categoryDesc.tea_alcohol: Tea and alcohol culture: Taiwanese tea ceremonies, oolong tasting, craft beer, and whisky appreciation events.
categoryDesc.tech: Tech events: Taiwan-Japan tech exchanges, AI/semiconductor forums, developer communities, and startup demos.
categoryDesc.tourism: Tourism events: Taiwan travel promotion, regional tourism introductions, and experiential itinerary briefings.
categoryDesc.tv_program: TV program events: Taiwanese dramas, variety shows, and documentaries broadcast in Japan, fan meetings, and watch parties.
categoryDesc.radio_program: Radio programs: Japanese-language broadcasts from RTI (Radio Taiwan International) covering music, culture, and Taiwan-Japan exchange.
categoryDesc.urban: Urban and city topics: Taiwan-Japan urban planning, architecture, community building, and regional revitalization.
categoryDesc.workshop: Workshops and hands-on courses: Taiwanese cooking, crafts, language learning, and cultural experiences.

home.lineCta: Join LINE for the weekly highlight
home.heroPara: Every day we catch Taiwan-related events happening across Japan! Tokyo Taiwan Radar lets you browse them in Japanese, English, and Traditional Chinese on one page. Cinema, music, food, exhibitions, lectures, markets — the Taiwan you'll find around your neighborhood, delivered every morning.
home.introP1: Tokyo Taiwan Radar is dedicated to collecting every Taiwan-related signal across Japan, deepening mutual understanding between Taiwan and Japan, and fostering exchange of cultural, social, and economic experience.
home.introP2: We currently monitor 100+ sources automatically and update daily at 09:00 JST. Coverage spans Taiwan-related events across all of Japan, including film screenings, performing arts, lectures, food markets, academic exchange, and 30+ other categories.
home.introP3: Beyond Tokyo, we cover Osaka, Kyoto, Fukuoka, Sapporo, Nagoya and many more regions. Data comes from official organisers, ticketing platforms (Peatix, Eventbrite), news outlets, and arthouse cinema websites.

about.story: Tokyo Taiwan Radar is dedicated to collecting every Taiwan-related signal across Japan, deepening mutual understanding between Taiwan and Japan, and fostering exchange of cultural, social, and economic experience.
about.sourcesBody: We currently monitor 100+ sources automatically, including official organiser websites, ticketing platforms (Peatix, Eventbrite), arthouse cinema sites, government cultural institutions (Taiwan Cultural Centre, Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office), academic institutions (Waseda, U-Tokyo, Kyoto U), and news outlets (NHK, PRTimes, Walker+). Full list available on the
about.techBody: This site runs daily at 09:00 JST via GitHub Actions, with scraping, GPT-4o-mini translation, and categorisation feeding into a Supabase database. The frontend is built on Next.js 16 with Tailwind CSS and deployed on Vercel. Source code is open on GitHub:
